decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-d1c86510-7fff-6f79-b404-b81e8a47aca3"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The proposed development, by reason of insufficient and inadequate information fails to demonstrate compliance with the approved Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS) and Tree Protection Plan (TPP) relating to application reference (</span><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">2016/1003 granted 02/02/2018), </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; white-space-collapse: preserve;">and the failure to plot the Root Protection Areas (RPAs) of retained trees on the submitted plans, fails to address the council’s concerns that the proposal could result in harm to TPO trees through root disturbance or changes in soil hydrology. As such, the proposal is therefore contrary to policy LP51 of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020) and policy G7 of The London Plan (2021).</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;"><span id="docs-internal-guid-d1391be0-7fff-5f69-e1b5-53c98d371647"></span><br></span></p>

<span id="docs-internal-guid-d8b062d1-7fff-e55c-b773-d49e1fc7ed15"><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed additional depth at ground and first floor levels, by reason of its excessive size and scale, would result in an overly dominant extension to the host building, which affects the setting of the building within the site, also amounting to an overdevelopment of the site. The extension would not be subordinate to the host building and would reduce separation from Arbor Court, harming the significance of the non-designated asset of number 69 Lordship Road, the character of the site, and its surroundings. The proposal is therefore contrary to policies D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach) and HC1 (Heritage conservation and growth) of The London Plan (2021) and policies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character), LP3 (Designated Heritage Assets), and LP4 (Non-designated Heritage Assets) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020).</span></p><div><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;"><br></span></div></span>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-8b74d0fd-7fff-b578-d0d9-ef8025b271b1"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The proposed development, by reasons of insufficient and inadequate information, including failure to submit an energy assessment, fails to demonstrate compliance with the council's sustainability and climate change policies. As such, the proposal is contrary to policies LP54 (Overheating and Adapting to Climate change) and&nbsp; LP55 (Mitigating Climate change) of The Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020) and policies </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">SI 2 (Minimising greenhouse gas emissions) and</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;"> SI 4 (Managing heat risk) of The London Plan (2021).</span></p>
description: Application under section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act (as amended) to vary conditions 2 (Approved Details) of planning permission 2016/1003.
